This [[Lhosan Industries]] '''plant''' was located near [[Machineville]] in the [[Lower City]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. In [[3963 BBY]], the plant's employees evacuated during the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Taris Siege|invasion]] of Taris. Afterward, thousands took shelter in the abandoned plant, only for their newfound sanctuary to be destroyed.
